class.name: BudgetBankNative
class.brief_description: Native iOS features for BudgetBank (BudgetBank fork).
class.description: Review prompt and the iOS keyboard's space-bar caret, which Godot 4.6 does not forward. Used by BudgetBank's Native.gd.

method.name: install_keyboard_caret_hook
method.description: Forwards caret moves made with the iOS keyboard's space-bar trackpad as [signal keyboard_caret_moved]. Returns [code]true[/code] when installed. iOS only.

method.name: ping
method.description: Returns [code]"pong"[/code]. Smoke test that the module loaded.

method.name: request_review
method.description: Asks iOS to show the App Store review prompt; iOS decides whether it appears. iOS only.

signal.name: keyboard_caret_moved
signal.description: The caret moved to [param column] (characters); [param length] > 0 when text is selected.
